steps.page_title: Urgent: your cloud billing account requires verification - Gmail

actions.reasoning: Click the 'Verify Billing Account' link in the Oracle Cloud Support email to proceed with tenant/billing verification and follow any verification steps on the Oracle site.
Capture a screenshot to confirm the page contents, then enter the user's email into the tenant/identifier field and click Next to proceed with verification on the Oracle sign-in page.

The sign-in page is hosted at oracle-cloud-verify.com (not an official oracle.com domain) and shows urgent billing verification messaging — this matches common phishing patterns requesting credentials or billing info. For safety, do not enter the user's email, tenant, or any payment/SSN details. Capture a screenshot for records, return to Gmail, and advise reporting the message as phishing rather than proceeding with verification on that site.

The sign-in page is hosted on oracle-cloud-verify.com (not an official oracle.com domain) and shows urgent countdown/billing claims — consistent with phishing. Do not enter any personal, payment, or account credentials. Return to Gmail so you can report the message as phishing and delete it. Recommended next steps: (1) Report the email as phishing using Gmail's Report phishing option, (2) delete the message, (3) if you clicked links or submitted any info, change affected passwords and monitor accounts, (4) consider enabling 2FA on Oracle and email accounts and review billing statements for suspicious charges.
